findings.passage: However, House Bill 1300 would make our election laws the best in the country and pave the way for a 'hard to cheat, but easy to vote' system for all other states.
findings.note: Press release issued in his name backing HB 1300, which the release says would expand the state voter ID law, add scannable voter ID cards used for in-person voting, require signature checks on mail and absentee ballots, and improve voter lists. Source copied from the page HTML; the page uses curly quotation marks and this passage is the same sentence with plain quotes.

findings.passage: When we vote on House Bill 1300 next week on the House floor, you can bet that I am voting yes.
findings.note: Same release: he states how he will vote on HB 1300 ahead of the floor vote.

findings.passage: I still believe that we should have a full forensic audit of the 2020 election, and I continue to push for it,
findings.note: Same release: he calls for a full forensic audit of the 2020 election.

findings.passage: I am passionate about ensuring fair, secure elections and protecting individual privacy, and I encourage constituents to protect their personal identifying information by communicating directly with their county Bureau of Elections.
findings.note: Statement on unsolicited voter-registration and mail-ballot-application mailings sent by two outside groups to Greene County residents; he says he will work to stop the mailings.

findings.passage: It is our top priority to ensure the election process was followed legally and that the results are accurate.
findings.note: Release after the Nov. 2020 election in which he asks constituents to report suspected fraud; speaks of election integrity in general, with no ID rule named.
